launches.title: Consus - The Github for Government Documents
launches.tagline: Stop pulling your hair out when working with government specs and requirements
launches.body:
**TLDR:**

Consus eliminates the chaos of government documents. We automatically verify active revisions, alert you to updates, and extract relevant requirements from complex documents. Help your team win more contracts and execute faster with Consus.

<https://youtu.be/ouFe09NHTo4>

**The Problem**

Government requirements slow companies down, particularly in aerospace & defense. When handed stacks of government requirements, program managers are expected to figure it out - with no guidance. Currently, they:

   ❌ Waste hours searching for the correct document version (often government counterparts don’t know)

   ❌ Sort through thousands of pages to find relevant information or requirements

   ❌ Avoid the headache by offloading to busy engineering teams

   ❌ Cross their fingers that they didn’t miss any requirements that will hurt the team in the future

**The Solution**

Consus transforms document compliance from a burden to a competitive advantage:

   ✅ Instant access to verified, active documents

   ✅ Automatic alerts for document updates affecting your projects

   ✅ AI-powered insights that surface relevant requirements in minutes

   ✅ One-click requirement extraction 

We work directly with government organizations to identify active document revisions. Our extraction tools get you the information you care about, and you will never have to guess the source of a requirement. 

If you are struggling to find and understand government documents, let’s [chat](https://calendly.com/eric-consusindustries/30min)!\
\
**The “Team” 🚀**

I spent the bulk of my career at SpaceX where I launched critical national security missions. Government requirements are important, but they need to be dramatically changed in form & distribution to unlock critical capabilities. If you resonate with the pain, let me know!

_Standing under a big rocket 🙂_
